info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Card By Param1-spec
info.description: The Card Network Participant Facility Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about a specific card network participant's facilities using a unique identifier. This endpoint is essential for banking applications and services that require insights into network participant capabilities. Typical consumers include financial institutions and developers integrating card management functionalities into their platforms. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their systems with real-time data on card network participants, facilitating better decision-making and customer service.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific card network participant facility by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a card network participant facility using its unique identifier, CARD-400045. You can expect a structured response that includes all relevant information about the facility.
